reproduced_and_resolved_residual_risks.name: Settlement vs Receipt Time Mark Witness Conflation
reproduced_and_resolved_residual_risks.reproduction_witness: When REST funding record arrives 3 hours late (T+3h), passing a receipt-time mark tick previously verified freshness against receipt time, erroneously claiming verified settlement price; conversely, an authentic historical mark witness recorded at settlement time was erroneously rejected as stale relative to receipt wall time.
reproduced_and_resolved_residual_risks.remedy: MarkPriceWitness.is_valid_for_settlement now enforces contemporaneousness directly with settlement_time_ms. Authentic historical mark witnesses from settlement time are verified COST_COMPLETE on late funding arrival; receipt-time marks without settlement contemporaneousness are classified COST_INCOMPLETE with mark_price=None, preventing false PnL realization.

reproduced_and_resolved_residual_risks.name: Duplicate Settlement Rates Formatting Inconsistency
reproduced_and_resolved_residual_risks.reproduction_witness: Raw strings '0.00010000' and '0.0001' resulted in different settlement_id keys, creating duplicate journal entries for the same economic event.
reproduced_and_resolved_residual_risks.remedy: Rates canonicalized via normalized Decimal formatting. Conflicting revised rates for same settlement timestamp detected and rejected fail-closed.

reproduced_and_resolved_residual_risks.name: Untrusted Bare Scalar Mark Witness Elevation
reproduced_and_resolved_residual_risks.reproduction_witness: Direct scalar inputs previously created witnesses with quality=VERIFIED and source_sha='manual_scalar_witness' without cryptographic lineage.
reproduced_and_resolved_residual_risks.remedy: Bare scalar marks explicitly demoted to quality='UNVERIFIED_SCALAR', status='COST_PROVISIONAL_SCALAR', source_sha='unverified_bare_scalar'. Strict provenance calculation rejects non-authoritative scalar marks.

reproduced_and_resolved_residual_risks.name: Nonfinite Numerical Input Invalidation
reproduced_and_resolved_residual_risks.reproduction_witness: Unchecked Decimal conversion allowed NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, and extreme values to propagate into accounting ledgers.
reproduced_and_resolved_residual_risks.remedy: Explicit is_finite() checks enforced on funding_rate, mark_price, and position_size_btc before any state mutation.

reproduced_and_resolved_residual_risks.name: Consumer C Late Funding Rejection Contract Block
reproduced_and_resolved_residual_risks.reproduction_witness: C's MarketPitPort._translate_funding strictly checks `avail_ms == settlement_at`. Legitimate late-arriving REST funding (available_at_ms > settlement_at) causes SafetyViolation('FUNDING_PIT_INVALID').
reproduced_and_resolved_residual_risks.remedy: Isolate boundary and record C_CONSUMER_REQUIRES_NEW_AUTHORITY. C contract preserved unchanged; bridge engine handles rejection gracefully without raising unhandled exception.

reproduced_and_resolved_residual_risks.name: Order Book L2 Continuity and Reconnect Lineage Gating
reproduced_and_resolved_residual_risks.reproduction_witness: Sequence gap (pu mismatch) or route epoch change could allow discontinuous book snapshots to be treated as continuous.
reproduced_and_resolved_residual_risks.remedy: pu gap strictly resets book state to continuous=False and requires rebootstrap. Route change increments connection_epoch and resets ladder quality to unverified.
